messages:
maria_support: Heads-up — customer acme-prod opened ticket #3421. Their Private/VPC console is showing empty metrics (CPU, GPU, tokens) for the tenant since ~03:00 UTC. They say API calls succeed (200s) but the dashboard has no ingestion. Can someone triage?

tim_eng-ml: I briefly looked — control plane logs show requests hitting the router and returning 200. Ingest pipeline logs show a lot of `tenant_id=null` events starting 03:00. Suspect tenant header getting dropped upstream.

chris_network: @maria_support can you paste an example request (headers) from the customer? Also which proxy in front of their private deployment (eg. nginx, envoy)?

maria_support: Provided sample curl from customer:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-Redwood-Tenant: acme-prod" https://private.example-corp.rw/api/v1/metrics/push
```
They say they set `X-Redwood-Tenant`. They also sent an nginx config they run in front of the private collector.

maria_support: nginx excerpt they sent: 
```
proxy_set_header Host $host;
proxy_pass http://internal-collector:8080;
# no explicit proxy_set_header for X-Redwood-Tenant
```

tim_eng-ml: That would do it. If nginx doesn't forward custom headers they get dropped. But the weird thing: earlier (before 03:00) it worked for same config. Any infra change?

metrics-ingest-bot: ingest-service: WARN tenant resolution failed, request_id=98f2, source=private-collector, tenant_id=null, timestamp=2025-03-12T03:12:04Z

chris_network: Could be a change in their nginx version or a new sidecar that strips headers (corporate proxy). @alex_oncall do we have network-level rules that might strip non-standard headers in private deploys?

alex_oncall: Not on our side by default. We do have a recent patch (rolled 03:00) to the ingress operator that adds stricter header normalization for security. It was applied to some private clusters as part of 2025-03-12 rollout. I'll check rollout logs which clusters were affected.

devex_kia: FYI customers commonly run a mutating webhook that adds/removes hop-by-hop headers. `X-Redwood-Tenant` is custom so it can be filtered unless `proxy_set_header` was set.

maria_support: Customer confirms they didn't change anything. They said metrics just stopped after our update window at 03:00. Looks correlated.

tim_eng-ml: Repro steps for eng:
1) Send a request with custom header to private collector behind our ingress operator
2) Capture request at collector (ngrep/tcpdump) and check if header arrives
3) If header missing, check ingress operator configmap `header-normalization` and recent operator image tags

chris_network: I pulled the ingress operator changelog — new default behavior removes `X-` prefixed headers unless explicitly permitted due to CVE mitigation. That explains why older clusters were fine until patched.

maria_support: Customer is blocked — dashboard empty for business-critical traffic. Any quick mitigation we can recommend to them?

alex_oncall: Short-term workaround: update customer's nginx to explicitly forward header: add `proxy_set_header X-Redwood-Tenant $http_x_redwood_tenant;` to their proxy config and reload. That will ensure tenant header arrives even if operator normalizes.

maria_support: Sent workaround to customer, they applied it and reported metrics reappeared after ~2 minutes. :thumbsup: They want permanent fix on our side so they don't need to change proxies everywhere.

tim_eng-ml: Permanent fix options:
- update ingress operator to whitelist `X-Redwood-Tenant` by default for private deployments (PR ready but needs review)
- change collector to accept tenant from auth token mapping if header missing (fall-back), but that requires token introspection and may be slower

chris_network: We should do both: short PR to operator to whitelist `X-Redwood-Tenant` and longer-term fallback in collector. I'll open the operator PR and tag eng-ml for collector changes.

maria_support: Customer asked for ETA — what's realistic?

alex_oncall: Operator PR can be staged today, can target canary within 24h and full rollout 48-72h after QA. Collector fallback will take longer (design + tests) — estimate 1-2 sprints.

devex_kia: Also update docs and quickstarts to include explicit `proxy_set_header` line for nginx/envoy to avoid repeat issues. I'll prepare a patch to the private deployment guide.

maria_support: Closing loop with customer now. I'll keep thread updated when operator PR lands. Thanks all.

chris_network: PR opened: https://git.internal/rw/ingress-operator/pull/512 (whitelist header). Linking internal issue: #INF-839.

metrics-ingest-bot: ingest-service: INFO tenant resolved=acme-prod, request_id=98f2, latency=22ms

maria_support: Customer confirmed stable for 30m and will reopen ticket if anything. Marking ticket for monitoring. :white_check_mark:
